propositions: ProviderSession is constructed before the try/finally guard, so code between construction and the guard that raises leaks an opened httpx client.
_check_tool_capability can raise LLMConfigError in the unguarded window, leaking one AsyncClient per affected call.
run() should wrap provider resolution through call and teardown in a with ProviderSession(...) block and drop the redundant finally: provider_session.close().
The assert_gated fail-closed security check must run before any provider client is constructed and must not be reordered into the guarded region.
The _NoBuildProviderSession test stub lacks __enter__/__exit__ and must gain them (returning self, calling close) in the same commit as the with change.
Best-effort teardown semantics must be preserved: a close that raises is logged and never propagated, and the happy path closes exactly once.
